end.summary:
Named ants and earthworms as animals found in soil.
Practised identifying small soil and leaf-litter animals; 2 unaided answers were correct.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil and how soil animals help make rich soil.
Earthworm-as-harmful-pest misconception remained; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming soil animals and used a pot comparison to discuss how earthworm tunnels help water enter soil. Pihu identified ants and earthworms, but mixed up earthworms with harmful crop pests; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, look under a leaf or in garden soil and make two columns: “helps soil” and “what it does,” including tunnels and breaking down dead leaves.
